transkript.t: These five github repos should genuinely be illegal.
All of them are free and you can download them today.
Number one is YTDL.
This allows you to download any video off the internet.
Number two is whisper.
It gets the words out of video
so Claude doesn't have to watch the video frame by frame.
Number three is last 30 days.
Typing the topic and Claude will search Reddit,
YouTube, all of social media
to see what people are saying about a specific topic
at that point in time.
Unbelievable for research.
Number four is cavemind.
It gets Claude to answer in shorter words
so your usage limits last way longer.
Number five is hyperframes.
It edits any video in any style you can imagine.
That's a full content setup for absolutely
for a comment repos below
and I'll send you all five links.
